limitations.areg_retained_state: Repeated Stata 19 areg HDFE calls retain substantial process state at 10 million observations. Large two-way areg measurements therefore use exactly one timed invocation per fresh Stata process; data generation remains outside timing.
limitations.areg_saved_fe: areg can predict the combined absorbed contribution but does not publish the separate fixed-effect coefficient vectors; it is therefore excluded from save_fe timing. Its e(df_a) convention also differs from reghdfe's, so parity is certified through VCE and fit rather than equality of that stored scalar.
limitations.greg_science: greg is checked for sample and slope parity, but remains diagnostic because its beta Mata interface does not expose the full e-class fit contract.
limitations.platform_threading: Both registered platforms use Stata 19. The macOS matrix uses 1 and 8 application threads; the SCC Linux license permits 1 and 4 application threads.
limitations.saved_fe_cross_command: Each command's saved predictor is checked against its own residual identity. Cross-command saved-predictor distances remain diagnostic because reghdfe uses a weaker saved-FE stopping rule than fereg.
